nodes.text: January says: if Aquarius holds,
keep away from all friendships,
for whomever you then choose for yourself
you will very soon lose.
February says: when Pisces hold,
then apply yourself [to this],
that you choose yourself a companion
for private matters,
for the sign is very good;
all joy comes to you with it.
March says: take no friend in Aries,
for you will part in ill will.
April says: when you find the sign in Taurus,
then you should not give up
until you win yourself a friend;
the sign has a good beginning
and a much better end. May says:
if you find it in Gemini,
then you may be quite certain
that good fortune follows you in the things
by which one is to win a friend.
Good fortune and honour follow you,
and it never parts again.
June says: if you find it in Cancer,
let that be least dear to you;
whomever you then choose,
you will lose him through envy and hatred.
July says: when you find it in Leo,
then do not wait at all;
choose yourself a friend quickly;
the love is lasting.
August says: if you find it in Virgo,
then take yourself a friend quickly
before the sign turns;
love and honour follow you.
September says: if you find it in Libra,
then you should give up all friendships;
you would have to part in anger;
you should avoid that sign. October says:
if you find it in Scorpio,
whatever friend you then win [further]
is fond of you for gifts;
but if you then leave off [giving] to him,
the love parts at once;
such is the nature of the sign.
November says: when it stands in Sagittarius,
all joy comes to you;
so hurry very quickly,
choose yourself a companion.
